name: Pizza
description: Authentic stone-baked pizzas with hand-stretched crusts and premium mozzarella.

name: Burger
description: Juicy, artisanal gourmet burgers stacked with fresh patties, cheese, and crisp veggies.

name: Biryani
description: Fragrant aged basmati rice layered with aromatic whole spices and slow-cooked to perfection.

name: North Indian
description: Rich royal gravies, soft tandoori breads, and fragrant authentic Mughlai curries.

name: South Indian
description: Crispy golden dosas, fluffy steamed idlis, spicy gunpowders, and aromatic sambar.

name: Chinese
description: Wok-tossed noodles, crunchy sizzling appetizers, dumplings, and spicy Sichuan bowls.

name: Italian
description: Handmade fresh pastas in silky white and tangy arrabbiata sauces, garlic breads, and lasagnas.

name: Snacks & Street Food
description: Mumbai pav bhaji, loaded peri-peri fries, crunchy chaats, and golden fried bites.

name: Healthy & Salads
description: Nutrient-rich power salads, quinoa bowls, fresh greens, and low-calorie gourmet treats.

name: Desserts
description: Molten chocolate lava cakes, royal gulab jamuns, cheesecakes, and creamy sundaes.

name: Beverages
description: Chilled artisanal mocktails, thick shakes, cold coffees, and refreshing coolers.
